Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the authorization.

I've opened an internal support escalation (SUP-8342) and looped our compliance engineer (Ben) and accounts lead (Sean) to coordinate. High-level next steps:
1) We need a signed authorization (we received the scanned letter — thanks) and a confirmation of the exact thread identifier(s) to remove (PX-2097 is what you referenced).
2) Our legal/compliance team will review the authorization (target: same business day if possible).
3) If approved, we will schedule a removal window. For a single-thread expunge we typically complete the work within 3-5 business days depending on backup retention windows and replication.
4) After removal, we can provide an attestation noting the systems cleared (application logs, KV cache snapshots, and audit export records) and a timestamp for when removal occurred. Note: deep backups or offline tapes may have separate retention constraints; we'll include a statement of what was covered.

Can you confirm that PX-2097 is the only conversation you want removed and whether you want a simple redaction (strip PII) or a full expunge from all searchable logs? Also please confirm the signer on the attached letter and that they have authority.

-Jordan
